status: B1, B2, B3, D1, D4, D5, D6 and F5 technically delivered; see publication-2026-09-10.md and publication-2026-09-11.md for evidence and limits. Recommended next batch: B4, D2, D3, E2. Other slices remain planned.
ready_rule: Dependencies have checked receipts/recipes published to main and their local handoff paths/hashes verified; branch from inspected current published main.
publication: Dedicated publisher integrates one checked worker at a time; ordinary non-force origin/main push under standing permission.

tasks.title: Broadleaf and pine canopy kit
tasks.outcome: Reuse the approved ART-02 trunk/rock language and deliver broadleaf/pine source masters, attached canopy variants, root contacts and matching felled/stump presentation. Establish clear near/middle/far asset candidates in game metres.
checks: Actual branch attachment, underside/clay review and no floating leaf masses.
Preserve native tree identities and finite full/felled state; no new harvesting rules.
Packed masters reopen; export orientation/bounds and visible LOD transitions pass.
tasks.notes: Start with existing approved grove sources; do not regenerate them merely to make the slice look new.

tasks.title: Ground cover and forest floor
tasks.outcome: Deliver a reusable low-plant/ground-material kit: saplings/shrubs, fern/bracken, meadow grass, bramble/climber, moss/lichen and leaf/needle litter. Make clusters and transitions, not a blanket scatter rule.
checks: Close and walking-height views show plausible attachments and nonrepeating ground transitions.
Tiled textures and coarse-to-detailed surfaces have no bright seams; record transparent overdraw.
Quiet ordinary materials, packed source reopen and two-renderer detail comparisons.

tasks.title: Rock, root-bank and cave-contact kit
tasks.outcome: Deliver matched boulder/stone-seam candidates plus modular bank, talus, shelf and cave-lip contact pieces. Preserve actual work faces and provide believable ground/rock intersections.
checks: All existing resource work/depleted states remain readable without new drops.
Actual support/cave entrance clearance, hidden-side geometry and resource body alignment.
No decorative collider or implicit extra resource for each pebble; packed and rendered checks.

tasks.title: First composed walk, light and distance
tasks.outcome: Compose one isolated small walk from B1–B3 and approved ART-02 context, demonstrating near/middle/far fullness, physical scar depth, water/foliage motion and readable lighting. Use existing audio direction with quiet gaps; no new sound pack is required.
checks: Matched day/shade/dusk, emission-off and actual pulse/wind captures in both renderers.
Open walking space, grounded contacts, depth measurements and pause-aware motion.
Separate uncontended benchmark, draw/primitive/texture costs and explicit candidate budgets; do not claim ordinary world integration.
tasks.notes: This is the first environment technical checkpoint; later slices reuse its measured conventions, not its entire dense composition.

tasks.title: Lantern Fen and Rustwater resources
tasks.outcome: Build leaning bog oak, finite clay bank and harvestable reeds with short decorative sedge and non-glowing fungal/wood detail. Compose a small wet-margin review without altering water, geography or stock.
checks: Bog oak, clay and reeds expose their own real work/aftermath states.
Decorative sedge/mushrooms cannot be mistaken for an added renewable harvest.
Wet ground contacts, daylight/shade, native work snapshot/reload and packed sources.

tasks.title: Glasswind and Shellcut quarry
tasks.outcome: Deliver layered slate, irregular fossil shellstone and low wind-worn tussocks, using B1 pine/B3 shelves for context. Source faces and worked material should visibly belong to the same family.
checks: Distinct full/part-worked/depleted quarry faces, exact native stock and restart.
Fossils vary and do not repeat as tiled medallions; split slate has actual layered silhouette.
Existing approaches and work-target envelopes retained; near/far review and cost report.

tasks.title: Resinheart and corkbark oldgrowth
tasks.outcome: Deliver resinheart oldgrowth and independently harvested corkbark deadfall. Reuse B1/B2 structure while exposing amber grain, porous cut bark and deep altered root wounds where appropriate.
checks: Tree and deadfall retain separate native work/save identities and exact depletion.
Recovered/cut material matches future resinheart/cork construction without adding emission to ordinary boards.
Attached crown/root anatomy, incision-off views, packed reopen and two-renderer review.

tasks.title: Recovering wastes and ash timber
tasks.outcome: Make ash snag/felled timber variants and sparse surviving scrub that create an inhabited damaged landscape. Reuse existing rock/ground families instead of inventing a lava biome.
checks: Standing/felled ash remains recognizable and respects native resource state.
Broken branches and surviving plants avoid repetitive spike-field silhouettes.
Readable traversal, quiet ordinary materials, day/dusk and cost evidence.

tasks.title: Ore-bearing rock family
tasks.outcome: Finish the five existing ore hosts as a related rock family with distinct internal mineral structure and matched worked faces. Preserve existing heat/work responses and era placement.
checks: Full, existing heated/cracked where applicable, part-worked and depleted native snapshots.
No changed access, heat requirement, yield, tool behaviour, era or save identity.
Clay/material views and both-renderer comparison make ores legible without universal bright crystals.

tasks.title: Ruins and workshop approaches
tasks.outcome: Produce surface/contact variants for existing ruin walls, thresholds, the old smithy and published LF approach marks. Pair worn masonry, roots and ground transitions without moving or sealing routes.
checks: Existing entrances, collision envelopes and source/route anchors remain unchanged.
Old accidental-impact craft and deliberate later containment remain distinguishable.
Actual before/after existing-scene views and a supported walking check; no new loot or recipes.

tasks.title: Core lattice geometry
tasks.outcome: Direct-model ten core shapes at their actual dimensions, including coarse clipped forms and low fieldstone pieces. Use provisional existing material families while material slices are authored.
checks: Exact native block/face/edge pivots, sizes and orientation; all joins fit without coplanar flicker.
Real coarse-grid placement, corner/support/ceiling cases and paired geometry/body bounds.
Material restrictions, occupancy, costs and saves unchanged; neutral and material views.

tasks.title: Roofs, door and metal spans
tasks.outcome: Direct-model seven existing roof/joinery/span forms around D1 join boundaries: three covering roofs, hinged door, full masonry wedge, metal girder and malleable arch.
checks: All legal turns, slope/hip/valley seams, door hinge directions/open-state and ceiling/corner contacts.
Existing half-height covering roofs vs full-height masonry wedge remain distinct.
No stone arch/door eligibility extension, new support system or changed world unlock.

tasks.title: Fine pieces and complete wall coverings
tasks.outcome: Finish five fine shapes and the two framed covering/glazing forms. Match the original lattice at half scale, with integral frames and material-correct surfaces.
checks: 0.5 m registry placement and exact coarse/fine joins, including small pillars/rails/shelves.
Fixed cinderglass window and light panel preserve shelter, projectile and movement blocking.
All legal family pairings, frame completeness, two-sided readability and imported sizes.

tasks.title: Timber, reed and cork materials
tasks.outcome: Author seven shared material families using the approved building sheet: five distinct timbers, woven reed and porous cork. Deliver reusable surfaces/atlas or tiling sources, mapping guidance and material swatches.
checks: Grain/end-grain/weave direction and scale at coarse/fine dimensions, neutral lighting and tiled seams.
No baked illumination, added glow, visible background contamination or new legal forms.
Exported texture colour spaces/sizes and both-renderer material review; compare against collected source concept.
tasks.notes: Can run alongside geometry sessions; use existing proxy shapes and publish stable texture names/mapping in its own manifest.

tasks.title: Stone, glass and fuel materials
tasks.outcome: Author eight existing mineral/glazing/fuel finishes: dressed vs rough stone, layered slate, fossil shellstone, fired brick, fused basalt, smoky fixed glass and charcoal fuel. Keep source-to-worked identity.
checks: Tiled joint/fossil variation, material scale and visible edges in neutral/light/dark views.
Charcoal only represents fuel; cinderglass has correct frame/mapping contract and existing blocking.
Opacity/reflection/normal behaviour in both renderers with measured texture costs.

tasks.title: Worked metal materials
tasks.outcome: Author four related but distinct hammered/cast metal families, with joint/rivet treatment suitable for buildings, stations and fixtures. Broad material response must survive distance.
checks: Iron/bronze/steel/silver are distinguishable by finish and structural detail, not neon tint.
Malleable/metal/joinery restrictions remain data-owned; no extra component costs.
Neutral and shaded reviews on exact girder/arch or proxy geometry; correct linear ORM and shared texture costs.

tasks.title: Workbench and mason's yard

checks: Actual kit preview and paid placement in real wall/floor corners, rotations and both grid scales.
No genuine collision bypass; failed placement retains kit; success yields one usable native station.
Craft feedback, interaction, native ownership and fresh-process restore with packed model evidence.

tasks.title: Basic and improved forge

checks: In-place upgrade and later kit preview show correct existing global tier, with no extra kit.
Physical placement/corner fit, real forging and feeder attachment envelopes.
Cold/work/paused feedback, ownership and separate-process reload; no new recipe or fuel cost.

tasks.title: Chest and fire-setting piece

Real paid winding/trip, physical obstruction/pause, partial collection and endpoint removal.
